NARRATOR.desc: Documentary narrator: serious, brisk, suspenseful, respectful

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: London, 1888. In just ten weeks, five women are murdered in the dark streets of Whitechapel.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then a letter arrives at a news agency, written in red ink. It's signed: Jack the Ripper.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In one night, two women are killed. Police find a chalk message on a wall, and wash it away before dawn.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A man opens a parcel. Inside is a letter that begins From Hell, and half of a human kidney.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Hundreds of suspects. A barber. A lawyer found drowned in the Thames. Even a famous painter.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2014, a DNA test named a suspect. Scientists still argue about it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: More than a hundred and thirty years later, the killer has never been identified. But we do know the names of the women he took.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Their full story is on Unfiled Films.
